annotations.text:
Advanced filters, mobile (375x812).
Three directions for the same feature set.

All three share: bottom sheet, drag handle, Reset all in the header, a sticky "Show N titles" footer, the year as two fields instead of a slider, and platform chips identified by monochrome mark + label (no brand colour, per the site-wide rule).

OPTION A - Sectioned scroll

Everything on one scroll, in labelled sections. Closest to what is there now, so the smallest build.

For: nothing hidden, scannable, easy to extend.
Against: already ~550px of content before the platform list grows. The two platform groups both sit open, which is the least clever answer to the games / streaming split.

OPTION B - Accordion

Every filter is a one-line row showing its current value; one expands at a time.

For: the whole filter set fits with no scrolling, and you can read your current state at a glance. Best of the three for "what did I set?".
Against: one extra tap to change anything, and you cannot see two filters' options at once.

OPTION C - Category tabs

A chip strip picks a category; the pane below shows only that one.

For: scales best if filters keep being added, and gives each category room (note the per-platform title counts, which need the pool query but are the thing that makes this filter feel alive).
Against: most chrome, and it hides the other categories entirely - you filter blind unless the chips carry counts.

PLATFORM FILTER - read before building

The data is already derived per item (platforms / streamingProviders) and simply not copied onto the discovery vector. No migration, no provider re-fetch.

Four things that change the design:
1. Streaming data in the pool is resolved for DEFAULT_COUNTRY, not the viewer's region. Option C says this out loud; A and B do not yet.
2. platforms is games-only, streamingProviders is movies/shows-only. Every option has to answer this - A shows both groups, B and C switch.
3. storeLinks is a mixed bag (Steam, GOG, but also IMDb, Reddit) - not usable as a filter without an allowlist.
4. Browsed rows may hold no provider data at all. Decide whether unknown is hidden or shown - a filter that silently drops them reads as broken.

Full detail: docs/advanced-filters.md
